description: Single compact fantasy RPG skill icon, crisp 16-bit pixel art, bold clean dark outline, 3 shades per color, simple readable silhouette, centered with 5 pixel empty margin, no frame, no letters, transparent background. Protective barrier skill: a single round cobalt blue shield with a bright turquoise rim, a small silver central boss, and a pale cyan crescent of protective light hugging one edge. Shield dominates, no weapons.
